large_bindings_content_scope: Existence only here; root POST_PURGE_GATE_VERIFIED.json records full exact gate verification. No model/large raw read.

pip_cache_cleanup.scope: stale pip HTTP download cache only; not installed packages/wheels/models or experiment files
pip_cache_cleanup.verification_scope: Execution receipt observed; this checker did not reconstruct missing per-file pip inventory or inspect installed packages.

untouched_scope: This check only read listed old targets, preserved explicit dependencies and selected raw stat markers. It did not delete or modify any run, RL, camera_mode, pipeline/control source, cache or active full46.
historical_replay_limit: Deleted raw cannot be revalidated by old hashes or PASS summaries. Selected old bag/cloud/full diagnostics are unavailable; preserved historical metadata stays original.
